description: Historical Flood Extents NSW 2012 is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW State Emergency Service. Flood mapping extents from air photography taken during the 2012 western NSW flooding are published by the NSW State Emergency Service (NSW SES) for community access and research purposes. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher NSW State Emergency Service. Its tags are Emergency, Flood. It offers 1 resource(s) in kml. The portal shows 2016-07-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
